failed_attempt.error: Prime RL's pinned deps/pydantic-config submodule had the correct Git object checked out but its tracked working-tree files were all staged as deleted, so uv stopped before dependency resolution with a missing pyproject.toml error.
failed_attempt.evidence_disposition: Preserve the first launcher log locally and in the terminal evidence bundle; do not reinterpret it as a scientific run.

bounded_repair.change: After the exact pinned submodule update, run git reset --hard HEAD inside each of the three required dependency submodules so their tracked working trees match their already-pinned commits.

authorization: The parent protocol explicitly permits one versioned outcome-independent launcher/environment repair before any natural completion. This amendment consumes that allowance.
